title: Intelligence Operations and Fusion Warrant Officer (III) (CWO5 to WO) PMOS, DIR INTEL
raw_text:
4. MOS 0205, Intelligence Operations and Fusion Warrant Officer (III) (CWO5
to WO) PMOS, DIR INTEL

    a. Summary. The Intelligence Operations and Fusion Warrant Officer
(0205) is a subject matter expert in intelligence operations, trained to
support the Marine Air Ground Task Force (MAGTF) Intelligence Officer (0202),
commanders, and staff. This role includes advising on the planning,
collection, integration, and execution of all intelligence disciplines. The
Intelligence Operations and Fusion Warrant Officer directs intelligence
processes to enhance operational effectiveness by applying analytic methods,
implementing doctrine, and leveraging capabilities to support MAGTF planning
and operations. Responsibilities also include developing and overseeing
multi-discipline intelligence training plans, encompassing individual skills
to collective training and readiness tasks. Additionally, the role involves
supporting intelligence systems acquisition and integrating emerging
technologies into current and future operations. The Intelligence Operations
and Fusion Warrant Officer excels in critical thinking and maintaining
connections across intelligence disciplines, units, and organizations to
optimize resources. Assignments may include Marine Corps intelligence
battalions, expeditionary units and forces, major subordinate commands,
Marine Corps Intelligence Activity, Marine Corps Intelligence Schools, Marine
Forces Commands, and Headquarters, U.S. Marine Corps. Additional assignments
may be allocated based on needs of the Marine Corps.


                                          1-10                       Enclosure (1)
 1105                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



       b.   Prerequisites

        (1) Must meet eligibility and appointment criteria as prescribed in
MCO 1040.42B, WO and LDO accession programs.

        (2) Security requirement: must have a current single scope
background investigation/T5 investigation and adjudicated for sensitive
compartmented information (SCI) eligibility.

        (3) Must have successfully served two or more years in the operating
forces holding one of the following PMOSs 0211, 0231, 0241, 0261, 2629. This
prerequisite may be waived for extremely qualified applicants from other
intelligence and information occupation fields on a case-by-case basis by
HQMC, DC I, Intelligence Division.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Warrant Officer Basic Course (WOBC) (M02RMN4) within
18 months of appointment to WO.

        (2) Complete the MAGTF Intelligence Operations and Fusion Course
(MIOFC) (N46HE12), Marine Corps Intelligence Schools, Marine Corps Detachment
Dam Neck, VA.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (g), Intelligence Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Military Officer Special and Tactical Operations Leaders/Managers, All Other
55-1019.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade.
